classifiedFinding.title: phUSD-is-stake-AND-reward tokenomic compounding spiral

classification.assetImpact: Stated APY overstates dilution-adjusted real APY; passive stakers diluted by compounders; phUSD supply expansion is unbounded under uncapped APY.
attackPath: 1. Sophisticated staker repeatedly claims and re-stakes.
2. Compounder's share of totalStaked grows faster than passive stakers'.
3. Passive stakers experience effective dilution; published APY is misleading.
classification.likelihood: high — rational compounding behavior; no special privileges

classifiedFinding.justification: Design observation, not a vulnerability. Profile §8.5 confirms no invariant violation; sanitizer hinted potential-low. C4 routes tokenomic / design-intent findings without exploitation primitives to QA. Pair with DEDUP-006 commentary on uncapped APY in the C/QA bundle.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-low. Classifier agrees: QA-level commentary, not a standalone Medium.
